title: Pakistan 🇵🇰 vs the world: true or false? 3 rounds
headline: Pakistan vs *the world*
description: Pakistan against Turkey, America and Russia. Three true-or-false rounds with real World Bank data. How many did you get right? Comment your flag.
source: World Bank: land area (2024), armed forces personnel (2020), population (2025), data.worldbank.org

ur.title: پاکستان 🇵🇰 بمقابلہ دنیا: سچ یا جھوٹ؟ 3 راؤنڈ
ur.description: پاکستان بمقابلہ ترکی، امریکہ اور روس۔ اصلی اعداد و شمار۔ اپنا جھنڈا کمنٹ کریں۔

segments.text: Pakistan against the world. True or false? Pakistan is bigger than Turkey.

props.statement: Pakistan has more land than Turkey

segments.text: True. By just one thousand two hundred fifty square kilometers.
Round two. Pakistan has more soldiers than America.

props.statement: Pakistan has more soldiers than America

segments.text: False. America has one point four million. Pakistan has nine hundred forty-three thousand.
Final round. Pakistan has more people than Russia.

props.statement: Pakistan has more people than Russia

segments.text: True. Over a hundred million more.
How many did you get? Comment your flag.
